definitions.gloss: main text, body, main content (of a document, email, or book)
definitions.explanation: The primary content of a written work, as distinguished from headings, footnotes, appendices, subject lines, or other supplementary parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本文|ほんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write the body of an email.

examples.japanese: {本文|ほんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えて→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please read the main text before answering the questions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本文|ほんぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二十|にじゅう}→二十：00975_nijuu⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{別途|べっと}→別途：11881_betto⟧⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The main body of the contract is twenty pages, with a separate appendix attached.

notes:
USAGE:
{本文|ほんぶん} refers to the main body of any written document, as opposed to supplementary sections. It is used for:
- Emails: the body (as opposed to the subject line or attachments)
- Books: the main text (as opposed to the preface, index, or footnotes)
- Legal documents: the main provisions
- Academic papers: the text portion (as opposed to references or abstract)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本文|ほんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to state in the main text
- {本文|ほんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refer to the main text
- {本文|ほんぶん}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the body of the text
- ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本文|ほんぶん}: email body
